faq.q: What's the investment for karaoke at my event?
faq.a: Every package is built around your event — the duration, your guest count, and the venue. Most private events come in well within the range you'd expect for a full-service professional entertainer with concert-quality sound, lighting, and hosting. Fill out our quick quote form and we'll send you a custom number within a few hours. No obligation, no sales pressure.

faq.q: Do you travel to Chicago and the surrounding suburbs?
faq.a: Yes! We regularly serve the entire Chicagoland area in addition to Northwest Indiana. That includes the South Side, as well as suburbs like Orland Park, Tinley Park, Oak Lawn, and more. Travel fees may apply depending on distance.

Everything. Concert-quality speakers, wireless microphones, a large lyrics screen, dynamic LED stage lighting, a professional host/MC, 75,000+ songs, full setup and teardown, and social media content creation at no extra charge. You don't need to rent or bring a single thing.

faq.q: Can guests request songs in advance?
faq.a: Absolutely. You and your guests can submit song requests ahead of the event and we'll make sure they're ready to go. Just let us know when you book and we'll set up a request link.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: Summer and holiday weekends fill up fast — sometimes 4–6 weeks out. For the best availability, we recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance. That said, if you have a last-minute event, reach out anyway — we'll do our best to make it work.

faq.q: Do you need a stage or special power setup?
faq.a: No stage needed. We work in backyards, living rooms, banquet halls, bars, breweries — anywhere there's enough space for guests to stand and sing. We just need access to standard electrical outlets.

faq.q: Can you handle large events with 100+ guests?
faq.a: Yes — we've hosted events with 200+ guests. Our sound system is scaled to fill large spaces, and our host is experienced at managing big crowds and long song queues.

faq.q: Do you provide a certificate of insurance?
faq.a: Yes. If your venue requires a COI, we can provide one. Just let us know the venue's requirements when you book and we'll handle it before the event.
We accept payment via Square (credit/debit card). A deposit is typically required to secure your date, with the balance due on the day of the event.

faq.q: Do you play background music between singers?
faq.a: Yes — between singers we keep the energy going with curated background music that matches the vibe of your event. If you have a playlist preference, just let us know.

faq.q: What if my venue doesn't have a screen or TV?
faq.a: No problem. We bring our own large lyrics display — it's part of the standard setup. Your venue doesn't need to provide any AV equipment. We're fully self-contained.

faq.q: Is karaoke appropriate for mixed ages — kids and adults together?
faq.a: Absolutely. We host everything from kids' birthday parties to adult corporate events. Our host adjusts the energy and song selection to fit the crowd. For family events, we keep things clean and age-appropriate.

faq.q: Can you do a hybrid karaoke + DJ set?
faq.a: Yes — we can split the night between DJ sets and karaoke blocks, which works great for weddings or longer events. A common format is DJ for dinner and dancing, then karaoke later in the evening.

faq.q: How long do bookings typically last?
faq.a: Most private events run 2–4 hours. Bar residencies are typically 3–4 hours. Setup and teardown are not counted against your booked time.
